run_vr_kuka_simulation: run the pybullet VR simulation that loads a KUKA robot, PR2 gripper, and various objects for VR-controlled manipulation
create_constraint_fixed_joint: create a fixed joint constraint between two pybullet bodies using p.createConstraint with JOINT_FIXED type
create_constraint_gear_joint: create a gear joint constraint between two joints of the same body using p.createConstraint with JOINT_GEAR type
change_constraint_vr_sync: change a constraint in real time to sync a pybullet gripper position with VR controller events
load_urdf_and_set_joints: load a URDF robot model into pybullet and set initial joint positions using p.resetJointState and p.setJointMotorControl2
